```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Melt the data to create a long format
iris_melted = pd.melt(data, id_vars='species', var_name='feature', value_name='measurement')

# Create a box plot to compare the measurements between species
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='species', y='measurement', data=iris_melted, hue='feature')
plt.title('Distribution of Sepal and Petal Measurements by Species')
plt.xlabel('Species')
plt.ylabel('Measurement (cm)')
plt.legend(title='Feature')
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
